# OCSP Server Test Suite v1.0.1

Security and bug-fix release. No functional changes to the application.

## Security — cryptography dependency update

The `cryptography` pin was raised from `>=42.0.0,<44.0.0` to `>=49.0.0,<51.0.0`. The old ceiling held installs at cryptography **43.0.3**, which has six published advisories — several in certificate chain validation, directly relevant to this tool's OCSP signature verification and trust chain building:

| Advisory | Fixed in | Issue |
|---|---|---|
| PYSEC-2026-3554 | 49.0.0 | Wildcard SANs escape CA name constraints during chain validation |
| PYSEC-2026-3553 | 49.0.0 | Exponential blowup (DoS) resolving chains with duplicate self-signed certs |
| PYSEC-2026-35 | 46.0.6 | DNS name constraints not validated against the presented peer name |
| PYSEC-2026-2141 | 46.0.5 | EC public key loading accepts small-order subgroup points |
| PYSEC-2026-1284 | 44.0.1 | Security issue in OpenSSL statically linked into cryptography wheels |
| GHSA-537c-gmf6-5ccf | 48.0.1 | Security issue in OpenSSL statically linked into cryptography wheels |

**Upgrading an existing install:**

```bash
git pull            # or download the new ZIP
pip install -r requirements.txt --upgrade
```

New installs automatically get a fixed version (cryptography 49.x–50.x).

## Fixed

- `ocsp_signature_verifier.py` crashed on startup with an `IndentationError` in `display_verification_results` (mis-indented overall-result block).
